_comment: Divisions are configured here. Create judge panels on the Panels tab after you know
how many judges are available; the interface assigns each new panel a unique login code.
`booking` sets the bookable time slots every panel starts with. startTime is a
24-hour clock time on the day the panels are created; set exact dates later in
Admin > Panels if you need to. Set slotCount to 0 for a walk-up queue only.
A panel can override any of these with its own slotMinutes / slotCount / startTime.
`languages` are the languages interviews run in. A team asks in one of them,
and each panel says which it can cover; a request that lands on a panel not
covering it is flagged rather than blocked, so you can still reassign.
`teamCategories` is the notebook classification. The FIRST one listed is what
a team gets until someone says otherwise — put `ungraded` first if you would
rather teams start unclassified and be graded up. Rename the labels or change
the colours to suit your event; keep the ids stable once teams are assigned.
`awards` are what judges nominate teams for and the Judge Advisor decides, per
division. The order here is the order everywhere. Keep the ids stable once a
nomination has been made; label, short and blurb can be reworded freely.

awards.label: Excellence
awards.blurb: Overall excellence in the Engineering Notebook, Team Interview and competition performance.

awards.label: Design
awards.blurb: An organized, student-driven Engineering Design Process.

awards.label: Innovate
awards.blurb: A novel, well-documented part of the robot design or gameplay strategy.

awards.label: Amaze
awards.blurb: A highly capable, competitive, consistently performing robot.

awards.label: Build
awards.blurb: Robot construction, craftsmanship, reliability and attention to detail.

awards.label: Create
awards.blurb: A creative engineering solution to this season's game.

awards.label: Judges
awards.blurb: Qualities worth recognising that may not fit another award.

awards.label: Inspire
awards.blurb: The passion, enthusiasm and spirit of the program.

awards.label: Sportsmanship
awards.blurb: Respect, professionalism, fairness and positive conduct all event.

awards.label: Energy
awards.blurb: Enthusiasm, excitement, positivity and spirit that lift the event for others.
